label: Mimosa C5x Modular Radio (N5-X antennas)
description: Mimosa C5x modular PtP/PtMP radio, 700 Mbps IP (866 PHY), takes N5-X series antennas. 1x 1G RJ45 with passive PoE-in (24-56 V).
notes: Vendor figures from the C5x datasheet: **1 gigabit Ethernet port 10/100/1000**, **passive PoE 24-56 VDC**, **max throughput 700 Mbps IP (866 PHY)**. The radio is **modular**: the antenna is a separate N5-X part (8/12/16/20/25/30 dBi), so the same spec covers a 700 Mbps backhaul and a subscriber link - the antenna is what changes.
